ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool designed for CSIDC to track land usage compliance and industrial expansion in Chhattisgarh.
ideas.title: Chhatisgarh Industrial Compliance & Satellite Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets regional state industrial priorities and replicates a proven runner-up pattern from the Xcelerate Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-localized platform for traditional Chhattisgarh artisans featuring automated multilingual cataloging and direct AI marketing assistance.
ideas.title: Bastar Artisan AI Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines local cultural relevance with a functional AI marketing copilot model that secured a 1st place win elsewhere.

ideas.pitch: An IoT and machine learning web platform predicting water contamination and algal blooms in local water bodies days in advance.
ideas.title: Mahanadi Basin Water Quality Risk Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven environmental prediction architecture that won the AquaSense IoT Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A predictive modeling tool using Poisson regression and geospatial data to forecast and visualize deforestation risks in local green belts.
ideas.title: Chhattisgarh Forest Land Cover Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous statistical modeling and calibrated prediction intervals, matching the winning formula of the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An interactive clinical simulation platform assessing community health workers through structured rubrics and computer vision pose tracking.
ideas.title: Rural Chhattisgarh Health Worker Clinical Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates complex real-world utility for regional healthcare delivery, mirroring the grand prize winner at the Cornell AI Hackathon.
